title: Private tour of the Isle of Orleans and Montmorency Falls
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by at least one adult.
policies: This is a private visit/activity. Only your group will participate.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Your tour will begin at the foot of Montmorency Falls, where I will tell you its fascinating story. We will then drive up to the top of the waterfall to discover the Wolfe Redoubt and its historical significance. Finally, we will cross the suspension bridge over the waterfall, before making a detour to Manoir Montmorency.
